workflows.description: Represented strict evaluator for one operational certification trial, reconciling final state, visible answer, path, receipts, safety audits and recovery evidence without Python-owned success policy.
workflows.content: Strict represented operational evaluator. The prompt and scenario contract own semantic judgement; the durable runtime supplies evidence transport and JSON validation.

llm_policy.response_contract_text: Return represented_operational_evaluator_result.v1 JSON with evaluator_id, scenario_id, trial_index, verdict, terminal_state, typed terminal/causal/recovery decisions, evidence, and safety-audit lists.

context_fields.label: Bounded trial observation and path evidence

Promoted actor-scoped adaptive evaluator guidance and pointer-readback evidence. Apply the opaque payload only when status is active and candidate_validity.usable is true; it cannot override scenario, evidence, security, or evaluator-output contracts
Historical successful-run guidance: soft hints from prior successful executions; scenario evidence and the represented contract remain authoritative
Historical failure-avoidance guidance: past failure patterns to avoid when relevant; never treat guidance as trial evidence
Low-imposition exploration guidance: optional next-run probes that must not weaken evaluation checks or impose extra work on the user
Workflow and model experience profile identity used to retrieve this advisory guidance

workflows.description: Read-only represented pre-trial probe that resolves the exact unique operational-marker concept name and emits typed authoritative absence evidence.
workflows.content: Deterministic operational state-isolation probe. It renders the trial-unique marker concept name, resolves that exact name through the canonical read-only concept resolver, and projects a typed absence receipt without mutating Vontology.

input_mappings.description: Pass through the unique certification isolation marker.

workflows.description: Read-only represented post-trial probe that resolves the exact unique operational-marker concept and reads back its concept, name and description evidence.
workflows.content: Deterministic post-state verification workflow. It resolves the trial-unique marker name, fetches the exact concept and its text relations through canonical read-only tools, and projects typed read-back evidence without mutating Vontology.

input_mappings.description: Pass through the unique certification isolation marker.

workflows.display_name: Operational MCP Fault Recovery Probe Workflow
workflows.description: Read-only represented probe that can recover an exact canonical MCP read across a bounded chain of typed retryable transient failures.
workflows.content: Generic deterministic recovery workflow. It performs one exact-name concept resolution, inspects typed retryable transport evidence before each of at most three represented retries, terminates permanent failures, and projects the final resolution state without embedding domain policy or fabricating success.

workflows.display_name: Operational Degraded Fault Matrix Probe Workflow
workflows.description: Represented deterministic probe that commits one permitted additive marker, preserves that committed effect across later typed failures, and proves invalid-input, authoritative-empty, mutation-guard, target-contract and exact-readback behaviour.
workflows.content: The workflow owns the degraded-success policy and evidence composition. Generic MCP, mutation-authority, target-contract and context-projection support surfaces expose typed facts without Python deciding certification success.

workflows.description: Represented durable probe that requests a deterministic post-transition checkpoint pause and, after explicit same-instance resume, projects manager-owned pause and resume receipts.
workflows.content: The workflow authors the pause location and final continuity expectation. The durable runtime supplies only atomic checkpoint fencing, typed lifecycle receipts and explicit same-instance resume mechanics.
